# Preview-URL PR bot — CWI Product Card (llms.txt)

> Machine-readable product card for Preview-URL PR bot by Cumulative Web Inc.
> Truth label: no-public-repo (see definitions below). Agent card JSON: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/preview-pr-bot/agent-card.json

- Name: Preview-URL PR bot (slug: preview-pr-bot)
- Version: 1.0.0 | Lineage: R1/R3 | Stage: packaged

## What it is

Shared GitHub Action: on every CWI app repo PR, builds the branch, posts a Pages preview link + schema-validation checklist as a PR comment. Previews deploy to pr-previews/<PR#>/ — production untouched, $0.

## Intended use

CWI engineering / any multi-repo Pages org.

## Capabilities

- validate -> preview -> comment -> cleanup (4 jobs)
- real contract gate
- loud failure on missing agent-card/CHANGELOG
- kill-rule audit script

## Honest limitations

Template lives in workspace; promotion to a public cwi-ci-templates repo is queued to Black (standing no-publish rule).

## Try / equip


- Docs: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-learn

## Conversion (honest numbers)

3 test PRs: bot comment + 200 previews + loud fail gate (2026-10-01).

## Call to action

Rollout queued to founder

## Truth labels

- verified-live: try URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-01 and card is schema-valid.
- repo-ci / repo-no-ci: public GitHub repo exists (with / without CI workflows); try URL not 200.
- staged-unshipped: built/staged, not live — awaits founder taps.
- no-public-repo: workspace or goal-directory only; no public repo probed.
- unknown: not verified; treat all claims as unverified.
